Lakinza Referral & Affiliate Program FAQ

1. How does the Lakinza Referral Program work?

It’s easy! When you join our referral program, you’ll receive a unique referral link or code. Share it with your friends, family, or followers. When someone shops through your link, they get 10% off, and you earn 10% in Lakinza store credit based on their order total.

2. What do I get for referring someone?

You’ll receive 10% of their order value as Cash or store credit, which you can use on any future Lakinza purchase. It’s our way of saying thank you for sharing the love!

3. What does my friend get?

Your friend gets 10% off their first order — just for using your referral link or code. Everyone wins!

4. Is there a limit to how much I can earn?

Nope — there’s no limit to how many people you can refer or how much credit you can earn. The more you share, the more you earn!

5. When do I receive my reward?

Your store credit will be added to your account once your referral’s order is completed and past the return window (usually 14 days after delivery).

6. How do I redeem my store credit?

Once you’ve earned at least $100 in credit, you can apply it to your next purchase during checkout or to your PayPal acount . Your credit never expires!

7. Can I use my referral link on social media?

Absolutely! Feel free to share your link on Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, blogs, or anywhere you connect with your audience. You can also make videos about our website and products, add your special link or coupon and post it on social media. 

8. How do I track my referrals and rewards?

Once you sign up, you’ll have access to your referral dashboard, where you can see your link, track referrals, and check your earned credits in real time.

9. Can I refer someone who has already shopped at Lakinza?

The 10% friend discount is only valid for new customers, but you’ll still earn credit if they use your link and place a qualifying order!

10. Who can join the referral program?

Anyone! Whether you're a happy customer, skincare blogger, influencer or content creator — if you love Lakinza, you're welcome to join and earn.
